# Online Free PDF Tools - Pdftools.net

Unlock the power of free online PDF tools at Pdftools.net. Merge, split, compress, convert, and edit PDFs in seconds—no installation, no registration required.

## PDF Tools

Pdftools.net provides a variety of tools for managing PDF files:

- [PDF to WORD](https://www.pdftools.net/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Word files.
- [Word to PDF](https://www.pdftools.net/word-to-pdf): Convert Word documents into PDF format.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.pdftools.net/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images into PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.pdftools.net/compress-pdf): Reduce the file size of PDF documents without losing quality.
- [Merge PDF](https://www.pdftools.net/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
